title: Quantum Dynamical Selection forbids reactions from non-symmetric states

statements.text: For small symmetric molecules, a Quantum Dynamical Selection rule precludes chemical processes that start from orbitally non-symmetric molecular states, so collective nuclear degrees of freedom need a full quantum treatment even at high temperature.

sources.quote: we conjecture a “Quantum Dynamical Selection” (QDS) rule for small symmetric molecules that precludes chemical processes that involve direct transitions from orbitally non-symmetric molecular states
